meta.name: auth-tool-cloudbase
meta.description: CloudBase auth provider configuration and login-readiness guide. This skill should be used when users need to inspect, enable, disable, or configure auth providers, publishable-key prerequisites, login methods, SMS/email sender setup, or other provider-side readiness before implementing a client or backend auth flow.

copy.tagline: 配置云平台认证提供商并检查登录就绪状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云平台上配置用户认证和登录方式
copy.tagline_en: Configure cloud auth providers and check login readiness
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure authentication providers and login methods on a cloud platform

howto.what: 当你要配置 CloudBase 的登录方式（如匿名、用户名密码、短信、邮箱、微信、Google 等），或检查、启用、禁用登录提供者及邮箱发件设置时，Claude 会指导你完成操作。
howto.when: 当你需要检查、启用、禁用或配置 CloudBase 的认证提供者、登录方法、公钥前提条件、短信/邮箱发件人设置，或在实现认证流程前确认提供者就绪状态时触发。

say.text: 检查当前 CloudBase 环境的登录配置有哪些方法已启用。
say.note: Claude 会调用查询接口并返回结果。
Claude 会读取当前策略并合并更新。

say.text: 配置邮箱登录，开启 SMTP 自定义发件服务器。
say.note: Claude 会提供修改 Provider 的步骤。

howto.what_en: When you need to configure CloudBase authentication providers (Anonymous, Username/Password, SMS, Email, WeChat, Google, etc.), or inspect, enable, disable login methods and email sender settings, Claude will guide you through the process.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to inspect, enable, disable, or configure CloudBase auth providers, login methods, publishable-key prerequisites, SMS/email sender setup, or confirm provider readiness before implementing an auth flow.

say_en.text: Check which login methods are enabled in the current CloudBase environment.
say_en.note: Claude will query and return the result.
Claude will read current strategy and merge the update.

say_en.text: Configure email login with custom SMTP server.
say_en.note: Claude will provide steps to modify the provider.
